policy.system_prompt: You solve graph problems using only the explicitly supplied edges and rules. All node names are arbitrary identifiers; their meanings give no evidence about edges or roles. Return only a JSON object with one nonnegative integer field: {"answer": INTEGER}.
policy.reasoning_policy: high effort when advertised; enabled otherwise; omitted only when unsupported
policy.provider_policy: one pinned endpoint per configuration; no fallback
policy.selection_policy: first usable response; no retries of wrong, invalid or cutoff answers
policy.budget_semantics: requested completion allowance; reported usage audited; no equal-compute claim
policy.scoring_unit: graph case; eight related variants are not independent observations
